meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 装上后，你可以用 /update-skills 命令让 Claude 检查并更新已安装的技能（如渠道和提供者技能），从上游仓库拉取最新代码并重新应用，同时保留本地配置和自定义。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /update-skills 命令时触发。如果工作区有未提交的更改，会先要求你提交或暂存。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills，更新所有已安装技能。
say.note: 会先检查工作区并列出可更新的技能。

say.text: 更新 Discord 和 Opencode 技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can run /update-skills to check and update installed skills (e.g., channel and provider skills), fetching latest code from upstream and re-applying while preserving local config and customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /update-skills in Claude Code. If the working tree is dirty, it asks you to commit or stash first.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills.
say_en.note: It checks the workspace and lists updatable skills.
